thesis: This episode argues that Facebook (META) and Google (GOOGL) are surprisingly cheap businesses with strong daily habit entrenchment and growth levers left to pull, despite their historical high multiples. The speaker contrasts these with Netflix and Amazon, which are excluded from the 'surprisingly cheap' group, and notes that Microsoft and Apple are deeply entrenched but not explicitly highlighted as undervalued in the same way. The thesis is thin, focusing primarily on the valuation gap between these tech giants and their IPO or current earnings multiples.
